div.head: X Atr 1
div.ab: Ðæt is þonne ærest, þæt we ealle fram synnan georne gecyrran ⁊ ure misdæda geornlice betan ⁊ ænne God æfre lufian ⁊ weorðian ⁊ ænne Christendom georne healdan ⁊ ælcne hæðendom mid ealle aweorpan.
Ðæt is þonne ærest, þæt we ealle fram synnan georne gecyrran ⁊ ure misdæda geornlice betan ⁊ ænne God æfre lufian ⁊ weorðian ⁊ ænne Christendom georne healdan ⁊ ælcne hæðendom mid ealle aweorpan.

Ðæt is þonne ærest: þæt we ealle fram synnan georne gecyrran and ure misdæda geornlice betan and ænne God æfre lufian and weorðian and ænne Christendom georne healdan and ælcne hæðendom mid ealle aweorpan.

Nämlich erstens nun, dass wir alle von Sünden eifrig umkehren und unsere Missethaten eifervoll büssen und Einen Gott stets lieben und ehren und Ein Christenthum eifrig halten und jedes Heidenthum durchaus verwerfen.
Namely, first, that we all turn eagerly from sins and zealously atone for our misdeeds, and always love and honour one God, and eagerly hold one Christian faith and utterly reject all heathenism.

The first provision is, that all of us zealously turn from sins and zealously make amends for our misdeeds, and love and honour for all time one God, and zealously uphold one Christian faith, and utterly renounce all heathen practices.

This is foremost: that we all zealously turn from sin and sincerely repent for our misdeeds and love and praise the one God forever and fully abide by the one Christian faith and entirely reject all heathen practices.
